fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The entity this group reaches by more than one ownership path. A declaration for an entity reached by one path is reported by the warehouse build, not refused: it may be made ahead of a link that arrives later.

fields.label: Consolidation Method
fields.description: The method the group applies to this entity where its ownership paths do not decide it. Proportional is refused until it is implemented (konsol#429).

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The first day this method applies.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: The last day this method applies. Blank means open-ended.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why this method and not the one the percentages suggest: name the arrangement, the holders and the standard, e.g. "60% held via two members under a joint arrangement with the co-venturer; joint control, IFRS 11.7". Who declared it and when is in the group's change history.
